import Base

def Life.lag(
  k: Nat, total: Nat, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  List.take(&2, U32,
    List.append(&2, U32, List.replicate(U32, k, 0), cells), total)

def Life.lead(+k: Nat, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  List.append(&2, U32,
    List.drop(&2, U32, cells, k), List.replicate(U32, k, 0))

def Life.rule(
  +width: U32, +i: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>,
  nw: List<&2, U32>, n: List<&2, U32>, ne: List<&2, U32>,
  w: List<&2, U32>, e: List<&2, U32>,
  sw: List<&2, U32>, s: List<&2, U32>, se: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case cell <> rest:
      match nw n ne w e sw s se:
        case nw0 <> nws n0 <> ns ne0 <> nes w0 <> ws e0 <> es sw0 <> sws s0 <> ss se0 <> ses:
          +x = U32.mod(i, width)
          +west = Bool.to_u32(U32.is_ne(x, 0))
          +east = Bool.to_u32(U32.is_lt(U32.inc(x), width))
          +near = (
            nw0 * west + n0 + ne0 * east +
            w0  * west      + e0  * east +
            sw0 * west + s0 + se0 * east
            : U32)
          Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(
            U32.is_eq(near, 3),
            Bool.and(U32.is_eq(cell, 1), U32.is_eq(near, 2))))
            <> Life.rule(width, U32.inc(i), rest,
              nws, ns, nes, ws, es, sws, ss, ses)
        case _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _:
          Nil{}

def step(
  +width: U32, height: U32, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +span = U32.to_nat(width)
  +total = U32.to_nat((width * height : U32))

  nw = Life.lag(1n+span, total, cells)
  n  = Life.lag(span, total, cells)
  ne = Life.lag(Nat.sub(span, 1n), total, cells)

  w = Life.lag(1n, total, cells)
  e = Life.lead(1n, cells)

  sw = Life.lead(Nat.sub(span, 1n), cells)
  s  = Life.lead(span, cells)
  se = Life.lead(1n+span, cells)

  Life.rule(width, 0, cells, nw, n, ne, w, e, sw, s, se)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+more:
      evolve(more, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
hypothesis: Replace per-cell linked-list indexing with eight whole-board lag/lead translations. Each translated plane is built by one structural prefix operation, then all nine aligned planes advance together in Life.rule. Prefix/suffix zero fill handles north and south boundaries; two column masks remove the only remaining artifacts, horizontal row crossing. This should preserve the previously observed behavior while reducing each step from quadratic linked-list retraversal to a fixed number of linear traversals. The explicit 3-by-3 plane layout also gives the implementation a tighter, more anticipatory vocabulary than the former tap/stencil decomposition.
findings: Confirmed, duplicate root cause: both perf-linked-list-indexing findings arise from Life.tap repeatedly calling linear List.get while Life.stencil walks every cell; evolve inherits that cost through step. The revision removes List.get entirely and advances aligned neighbor planes structurally. Prior runtime behavior passed and is preserved algebraically. The style feedback was advisory but actionable: lag/lead now form one reusable translation algebra, and the rule’s spatial 3-by-3 arrangement makes its setup and payoff explicit.
